entries.notes: Second pass, post-spray water-in for Maintain granular, gypsum, GroTurf, and Spartan+Acelepryn. Flow rate measured at 9.58 L/min this session (down from earlier 12.44 L/min reading).

entries.method: LinkTap sprinkler - Eco cycle (5 min on / 5 min off)
entries.notes: Pre-wet before spray application, to help dry/compacted soil absorb water rather than run off. Eco cycle pulses the valve to reduce runoff and save water.
